description: This file defines Spark metrics sources for Accumulators, including classes for handling Long and Double accumulators, and registration objects for integrating with Spark's metrics system.

classes.name: AccumulatorSource
classes.description: A Spark metric source that reports accumulator values as gauges, restricted to Long and Double accumulators.

classes.name: LongAccumulatorSource
classes.description: A subclass of AccumulatorSource for LongAccumulators.

classes.name: DoubleAccumulatorSource
classes.description: A subclass of AccumulatorSource for DoubleAccumulators.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a set of accumulators with the source, creating gauges for each.

methods.name: sourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the source, 'AccumulatorSource'.

methods.name: metricRegistry
methods.description: Returns the MetricRegistry instance used by the source.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers Long or Double accumulators with Spark's metrics system.
